Description: Unique identifier assigned to each participant.
Fluency round a response belongs to, numbered from 0 within each participant. One round is one timed attempt at one category cue.
Presentation order within the session (0-indexed). The order in which the participant saw this trial.
The linguistic or visual stimulus presented to the participant in a given trial.
Time taken by the participant to respond, in milliseconds.
Time from the onset of the round to this response, in milliseconds; the running total of rt within the round.
Time allowed for one round, in milliseconds. Documented by the published task, which sets timeperlist = 180 seconds; the value is 180000 for every participant in both files.
Flag marking RT outliers removed from RT analyses.
Flag marking a response already given earlier in the same round (a perseveration).
Flag marking a response whose category label disagrees with the majority label of the round it is stored in, i.e. one filed under the wrong round. The label itself is left as recorded.
